text: The National Emergency Management Agency (NEMA) is an executive agency within Australia's Department of Home Affairs, established on 1 September 2022. It was formed by merging the National Recovery and Resilience Agency and Emergency Management Australia to provide a unified national capability for disaster management. NEMA is responsible for end-to-end national leadership in preparedness, response, relief, recovery, and resilience against natural and non-natural hazards. It operates under the guidance of the Minister for Emergency Management and is led by a Coordinator-General. NEMA's mission includes 24/7 all-hazards monitoring, operational coordination, and funding programs like the Disaster Ready Fund to enhance community resilience and recovery.
